readme_snippet:
# DeepAgents Experiments

A collection of Jupyter notebooks exploring the [`deepagents`](https://pypi.org/project/deepagents/) framework — a LangGraph-based library for building production-ready AI agents with tools, memory, sub-agents, and human-in-the-loop controls.

## Notebooks

| Notebook | Description |
|---|---|
| `BasicDeepAgents.ipynb` | Create a basic agent with web search (Tavily), state backends (Filesystem, Store, ContextHub), and file I/O |
| `ContextEngineering.ipynb` | Inject context via system prompts, memory files, and skills into agents |
| `Validation.ipynb` | Human-in-the-loop middleware — interrupt agent tool calls for approval, editing, or rejection |
| `SubAgents.ipynb` | Orchestrate multiple specialized sub-agents (e.g., researcher + main agent) |
| `Harness.ipynb` | Use `HarnessProfile` to constrain agents, and dynamic sub-agents (reviewer + developer) with code interpreter |
| `Interpreter.ipynb` | Code interpreter middleware with `FilesystemBackend` and filesystem permissions |

## Key Concepts Covered

- **Basic agents** — `create_deep_agent` with LangChain tools and Groq/Anthropic models
- **State backends** — `FilesystemBackend`, `StoreBackend`, `ContextHubBackend`
- **Context engineering** — system prompts, memory files (`AGENTS.md`), skills (`SKILL.md`)
- **Human-in-the-loop** — `interrupt_on` with `approve / edit / reject` decisions via `InMemorySaver`
- **Sub-agents** — delegate tasks to named sub-agents with custom system prompts and tools
